title: CO mass upper limits in the Fomalhaut ring - the importance of NLTE excitation in debris discs and future prospects with ALMA
question: Is CO J=3-2 emission detectable in the Fomalhaut ring, and how does non-LTE CO excitation affect the derived CO mass upper limit and planetesimal CO/H2O ice ratio?

what.value: Dust model: Gaussian radial profile FWHM 16 AU centred at 143 AU, exponential vertical profile with 1 deg opening angle; dust temperature 48 K; ALMA continuum flux

evidence.quote: This consists of a Gaussian radial profile with FWHM of 16 AU and centred at a radius of 143 AU, and an exponential vertical profile with an opening angle of 1$^{\circ}$.

what.value: Ring orbital parameters used for velocity assignment

evidence.quote: Coefficients for H$_2$-CO collisions are obtained from the LAMDA database (cite: Schoier2005).

what.value: Collisional rates dust mass-loss rate 6.0e17 kg/yr

evidence.quote: has been estimated as $6.0\times10^{17}$ kg/yr (cite: Wyatt2002)

recipe.method: Repeat imaging of calibrated data at native channel resolution, 200-channel window around CO 3-2

recipe.goal: Search for CO emission with velocity-matched extraction
recipe.method: Select ring pixels from 4 sigma continuum, assign Keplerian velocity channel per pixel, sum flux in expected channels; also moment-0 map and unshifted integrated spectrum
assumptions: CO co-located with dust, Keplerian, axisymmetric ring

recipe.method: 3-sigma plus 10% calibration error, converted to Jy km/s, rescaled by whole-ring/partial-ring continuum ratio

recipe.goal: Non-LTE CO excitation and mass upper limit
recipe.method: Solve statistical equilibrium for levels up to jmax=24 over grid of f_cp, T_k (10-150 K) and CO/H2O ice ratio, with radiation field from CMB, star and dust model; convert flux limit to mass with Eq. 2
assumptions: Dust, colliders and CO co-located, axisymmetric; uniform T_k; colliders H2 (primordial) or e- and H2O (secondary)

recipe.method: Compare CO destruction rate upper limit (mass / photodissociation lifetime ~120 yr) to production rate from collisional cascade assuming steady state

answer_key.quantity: 3-sigma upper limit on integrated CO J=3-2 line flux

evidence.quote: This yields a final 3-$\sigma$ CO J=3-2 line flux upper limit of 0.16 Jy km s$^{-1}$

evidence.loc: 4.3 Results for the primordial gas scenario
evidence.quote: the 3$\sigma$ upper limit on the mass of CO in the Fomalhaut ring is thus 4.9 $\times$ $10^{-4}$ M$_{\oplus}$

answer_key.quantity: CO mass upper limit, secondary scenario

evidence.loc: 4.4 Results for the secondary gas scenario
evidence.quote: lead to upper limits on the CO and H$_2$O gas mass in the Fomalhaut ring of 2.5 $\times$ $10^{-6}$ M$_{\oplus}$

answer_key.quantity: Upper limit on CO/H2O ice ratio in planetesimals (steady state)

evidence.quote: allows us to set an upper limit of $\sim$55% on the CO/H$_2$O ice ratio in the parent planetesimals. This could drop to $\sim$3% if LTE applies
hence assume the photodissociation timescale of CO to be $\tau_{phd}\sim120$ years
